reports.headline: Hunted at the Crater
reports.body: Something stalks the old crater {dir} of the village {dist}. {name} felt eyes on {them} the whole way round its rim, and once saw a long shape move between the stones, quicker than a man. The dogs that follow it are only its hounds.

reports.headline: The Thing at the Crater's Edge
reports.body: The crater {dir} of here {dist} has claimed two hunters. {name} found their bows snapped and a trail of long, careful footprints leading down into it.
